name: notification
description: 发送系统桌面通知。用于提醒、报警等场景。
code:
def execute(arguments):
    """
    发送系统通知
    
    参数:
        arguments (dict): 包含以下字段
            - title (str): 通知标题，必填
            - message (str): 通知内容，必填
            - icon (str): 图标路径，可选
            - timeout (int): 显示时间（秒），默认 5
    
    返回:
        dict: 包含执行结果的字典
            - success (bool): 是否成功
            - title (str): 通知标题
            - message (str): 通知内容
            - error (str): 错误信息（失败时）
    """
    import subprocess
    import platform
    
    title = arguments.get("title", "")
    message = arguments.get("message", "")
    icon = arguments.get("icon", "")
    timeout = arguments.get("timeout", 5)
    
    if not title or not message:
        return {"success": False, "error": "请提供通知标题和内容"}
    
    try:
        is_windows = platform.system() == "Windows"
        
        if is_windows:
            ps_script = f'''
            [Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager, Windows.UI.Notifications, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] | Out-Null
            [Windows.Data.Xml.Dom.XmlDocument, Windows.Data.Xml.Dom.XmlDocument, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] | Out-Null
            
            $template = @"
            <toast duration="short">
                <visual>
                    <binding template="ToastText02">
                        <text id="1">{title}</text>
                        <text id="2">{message}</text>
                    </binding>
                </visual>
            </toast>
            "@
            
            $xml = New-Object Windows.Data.Xml.Dom.XmlDocument
            $xml.LoadXml($template)
            $toast = [Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotification]::new($xml)
            [Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager]::CreateToastNotifier("AITerm").Show($toast)
            '''
            
            result = subprocess.run(
                ["powershell", "-command", ps_script],
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                timeout=timeout
            )
            
            if result.returncode == 0:
                return {
                    "success": True,
                    "title": title,
                    "message": message
                }
            else:
                return {
                    "success": False,
                    "error": f"PowerShell error: {result.stderr}"
                }
        else:
            try:
                subprocess.run(
                    ["notify-send", "-t", str(timeout * 1000), title, message],
                    check=True,
                    timeout=timeout
                )
                return {
                    "success": True,
                    "title": title,
                    "message": message
                }
            except FileNotFoundError:
                return {
                    "success": False,
                    "error": "notify-send not found. Please install libnotify-bin."
                }
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return {"success": False, "error": "Notification timeout"}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}
